_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to change the game's words, then run: python build_voice.py  and  python publish.py

_fields.sentence: a short sentence using the word, so he hears it in context
_fields.challenge: true for harder bonus words (worth 3 stars instead of 2). Optional, defaults to false.
_fields.wrong: OPTIONAL. Three plausible misspellings for the multiple-choice stages. Leave it out and sensible ones are generated for you.
_fields.picture: OPTIONAL. Name of a drawing to reuse. Leave it out and the word gets a listen-only card instead.

_note: Every word here is used in every one of the five stages - the list is never split up.

words.sentence: My dog can run very fast.
The frog can hop very high.
There is a toy in the box.
We grow beans in our garden plot.
The apple did not cost much.
Do not be a slob with your food.
We stop at the red light.
The rock fell in with a plop.
